THRI.description: Time History Analysis Results - Inelastic Hinge (THRI). TYPE_ELEMENT selects the element category which fixes the meaning of PROPERTY_KEY, while TYPE_RES/LOCATION/COMP pick the graphed result quantity.

THIS_NAME.description: Name of the time history load case (T_THIS) this inelastic-hinge result graph belongs to; resolved to its internal key at set time.

TYPE_ELEMENT.description: Type of Element, which also determines how PROPERTY_KEY is interpreted. 0: Beam (element key), 1: Truss (element key), 2: Wall (User Wall ID), 3: General Link (nonlinear link key). Hard checks: when 0 the referenced element must be a beam and when 1 it must be a truss, otherwise the request is rejected.

PROPERTY_KEY.description: Key of the target object; its meaning depends on TYPE_ELEMENT: [TYPE_ELEMENT=0/1] element key, [TYPE_ELEMENT=2] User Wall ID, [TYPE_ELEMENT=3] general (nonlinear) link key. The referenced object must exist.

STORY_NAME.description: [GEN only] Name of the story (used when TYPE_ELEMENT=2, Wall); resolved to its internal story key at set time. Ignored in non-GEN products.

TYPE_RES.description: Type of Result. 0: Force-Deformation, 1: Force, 2: Deformation.

LOCATION.description: Location along the element. 0: I-Node, 1: J-Node.

COMP.description: Component of the result. 0: Fx/Dx, 1: Fy/Dy, 2: Fz/Dz, 3: Mx/Rx, 4: My/Ry, 5: Mz/Rz. [TYPE_ELEMENT=1] for a Truss this must be 0, otherwise the request is rejected.
